meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
- "The principal may not return the student to that teacher's class without the teacher's consent unless the committee established under Section 37.003 determines that such placement is the best or only alternative available."
- "A teacher shall remove from class and send to the principal for placement in an alternative education program or for expulsion, as appropriate, a student who engages in conduct described under Section 37.006 or 37.007 (those Category II and III offenses marked by an asterisk)."
- "Such a suspension may not exceed three school days (Section 37.005)."
- "The student may not be placed in an alternative education program solely for educational purposes if the student does not also meet the criteria for alternative placement in Section 37.006(a) or 37.007(a)."
- "If the ARD committee determines that the behavior is not a result of the student's disability, inappropriate IEP or placement, the student with a disability is subject to general education discipline (Section 37.006-37.007)."
- "A student with a disability may be placed in an alternative education program which has been deemed appropriate in the student's IEP by previous ARD committee action (Section 37.008)."
- "For the purpose of this section, a student who is disabled is one who has been evaluated in accordance with 34 Code of Federal Regulations 300.530-300.534 and TAC 89.G.233 and determined by an Admission, Review, and Dismissal (ARD) committee as meeting the eligibility criteria for special education services."

meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer:
- "*For the purposes of this document, the term \"parent\" is used to designate a natural or adoptive parent, guardian, or a person legally acting in a parental relationship to a child, or a surrogate parent who has been appointed by the district to act on behalf of a child in accordance to Public Law 94-142."
- "For the purpose of this section, a student who is disabled is one who has been evaluated in accordance with 34 Code of Federal Regulations 300.530-300.534 and TAC 89.G.233 and determined by an Admission, Review, and Dismissal (ARD) committee as meeting the eligibility criteria for special education services."
